set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- CI covers the chosen Scala LTS and current feature release, JDK 17/21, JVM and Scala.js.
- Every backend compiles and relevant unit/law/differential/fuzz/golden suites run.
- Documentation examples and links are checked.
set.title: [Intaglio 1.0][Assurance] Build the supported Scala, JDK, platform, and backend CI matrix
